item.title: Capsudo: Rethinking Sudo with Object Capabilities
item.description:

item.title: 50 years of proof assistants
item.description:
📝 They admit that computing is an exception: they don’t pretend that my personal 32GB laptop is not an advance over the 16MB mainframe that served the whole Caltech community when I was there. LCF-style proof assistants are a world away from mainstream computing, so let’s look at 50 years of progress there. It introduced proof tactics and also tacticals: operators for combining tactics.
🔗 Read more: https://lawrencecpaulson.github.io//2025/12/05/History_of_Proof_Assistants.html
